title: Brex customer stories
description: A cool-grey band that cycles through customer quotes. Desktop: three centred tab names on top (the active one underlined), a rounded photo on the left and the customer's name, a large serif quote, attribution and an orange link on the right. Phones: an accordion where the open row shows its photo and quote under an orange progress line. The story advances by itself every 8 seconds and crossfades over 400ms.
notes: media slot: a 648×482 customer photo or video frame
autoplay and the progress line are CSS; they are off under reduced motion (you can still click)
hovering the block pauses the timer
the quote uses var(--typeface-serif) and falls back to Georgia in themes without it
